examples.text: Pod domem asfaltują drogę, więc śmierdzi, ale potem będzie równo.

glosses: A sticky, black to brown and highly viscous liquid or semi-solid, composed almost entirely of bitumen with small mineral particles, that is present in most crude petroleums and in some natural deposits.

examples.text: The mining of asphalt was big business in this area in the early twentieth century.
Felltham wrote in the beginning of the 17th century of the “Bitumated walls of Babylon;” the source of its supply, the fountains of Is, on a tributary of the Euphrates, still yields asphalt.

glosses: Ellipsis of asphalt concrete, a hard ground covering used for roads and walkways.

examples.text: Please hose off the asphalt near the top of the driveway if the trucks get lots of mud on it.
